author: National Geographic
description:
Step out of fiction and into the chilling true history of real-world witch hunts. In this episode of WITCHES: TRUTH BEHIND THE TRIALS, go back to 18th century Ireland where the supposed demonic possession of a teenage girl triggered one of the most frightening persecutions in European history. In Islandmagee in 1711, mass hysteria led to the brutal trial and punishment of eight local women. Through cinematic reconstructions, scientific analysis, and expert interviews, uncover the tragic story that marked the beginning of the end of the witch hunt era. 

Witches: Truth Behind the Trials | S1 E6

Through its partnership with the National Geographic Society and as part of its Perpetual Planet Initiative, #Rolex supports expeditions exploring and protecting remarkable places around the world, a selection of which are featured in Africa Earth’s Wild Home. #PerpetualPlanet
 
Africa Earth's Wild Home, narrated by Wunmi Mosaku, premieres Friday, October 2 at 8/7c on National Geographic. Streaming next day on @disneyplus  and @hulu.
